title: Fold Laboratories Art Catalogue
description: Original art from galleries and artists: semantic search, provenance, live availability.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Without it you are served as an unidentified agent: search, full artwork detail and availability all work, with a watermarked, downscaled preview of each work's primary image and a per-minute rate limit. Tokens go to a named agent operator: send 'Bearer <token>' for every image at full size and no per-minute limit. Request one at https://foldlaboratories.com/agents.
